authors_reviews.title: Kit is Great, Sleeker Brush is Awesome!
authors_reviews.text: For the price, this grooming set was a welcome surprise with how many genuinely useful tools it includes. I won’t need every item, but I’ll use about 80% of what came in the kit. The tools are easy to handle, and the slicker brush is the standout for me. It’s well designed, a good size, and very effective at removing hair. The release mechanism works better than others I’ve used, which makes cleanup much easier.I have two cats — one long hair and one short hair — and both shed a lot. This brush works great on both of them. The nail clipper also performs as expected and cuts cleanly. The guard seems more suited for dogs, so cat owners should be mindful of that. The combs and shedding tools are solid and well made, and I tested each without any issues.I can’t speak much for the nail file, gloves, or the blue hand‑wrap brush, as those seem more geared toward dog grooming. However, based on the quality of the tools I did use, I’m confident they function as intended. I’m mainly glad I came across this kit for the slicker brush alone — I’ll be sticking with this design going forward.
authors_reviews.author: NuttleStuff

authors_reviews.title: Comprehensive 11-Piece Kit - Better Suited for Medium/Large Dogs, One Tweak Needed for the Gloves
authors_reviews.text: I got this for my Chihuahua, Charlie. Overall, it’s a well-thought-out set that covers nearly every grooming task in one box, though I found some pieces are sized more for bigger dogs.What’s Included: Slicker brush, comb, undercoat rake, nail clipper, towel, scrubber/massage gloves, and scissors.What I Liked:- Slicker brush + undercoat rake — effectively pull out loose fur and reduce shedding- Comb — great for finishing touches after brushing out mats or tangles- Towel — a nice included extra for post-bath drying- All-in-one convenience — no need to buy each tool separately; good value for the priceWhat Could Be Improved:- Nail clipper — this didn’t work well for my Chihuahua’s small nails. The clipper is sturdy and feels well-built, but it’s really sized for a medium or large dog’s nails rather than a tiny breed. If you have a bigger dog, this would likely work great — for toy breeds, you may want a separate, smaller clipper (I have one made for cats).- Silicone scrubber gloves — when used dry, they grip and pull at my dog’s hair a bit more than expected, and can stick slightly. I haven’t tested them wet with shampoo yet, but I suspect the soap and water would help them glide more smoothly. I’d recommend using these specifically during bath time rather than for dry brushing.Bottom Line: A solid, well-rounded grooming kit overall, though better suited to medium and large dog owners. Small breed owners (like Chihuahua parents) can use this kit but should probably find something meant for smaller dogs. With the gloves reserved for wet use, this kit handles most brushing and bathing needs effectively. Recommended for pet owners with medium to large dogs.
authors_reviews.author: Virginia

authors_reviews.title: Like a greatest hits album
authors_reviews.text: To be honest I wasn't expecting quality in a kit like this - for the price I figured they would cheap out on the tools but I was pleasantly surprised at how nice most of the items are. There was only one that wasn't up to par which was the nit comb, due to a few tines being slightly crooked. The scissors are sharp and have a satisfying cutting action. The file is nice and file-y. The gloves are about a size L compared to latex gloves. The nail clippers were sharp and cut well and left minimal burred edges. I was surprised that the comb was all metal. The slicker brush works amazingly well and self cleans easily. The microfiber towel is actually pretty big. The one minor "nit" I have with this set is that it covers both long and short haired dogs. I think they should have broken it up into a long haired set and a short haired set and made them cheaper. Otherwise you're bound to have useless tools unless you have both types of dogs. The long haired brush was useless for me and a waste. Otherwise I'm really happy with this set.

The nail clippers feel sturdy and easy to control, while the grooming scissors, bath scrubber gloves, and towel round out the kit nicely for a complete grooming experience.The tools are comfortable to use, feel well made, and hold up well with regular use. authors_reviews.title: Nice beginner kit
authors_reviews.text: This 11-Piece Dog Grooming Kit is a really nice starter grooming set, especially for the price. At $24.99, I think it’s an excellent value. If you were to purchase many of these tools individually, you’d easily spend much more than that.The kit includes a self-cleaning slicker brush, undercoat rake, grooming comb, grooming scissors, nail clippers, bath scrubber gloves, a grooming towel, and a storage bag to keep everything organized. Everything fit nicely inside the carrying bag, which makes it easy to store or take with you when traveling.One of my favorite items is the self-cleaning slicker brush. With the push of a button, the bristles retract and the hair comes right off, making cleanup so much easier. Those brushes alone can often cost $10–$15, so it was nice seeing one included in the kit.I also really appreciated that they included the bath gloves. I always hate washing my dog because my hands end up smelling like wet dog afterward, so having gloves is a huge plus. The towel was another thoughtful addition, and the scissors felt surprisingly sturdy and sharp enough for light trimming around the paws or other areas.Overall, all of the tools seem to be good quality, especially considering the price. I would say this kit is best suited for medium- to long-haired dogs since several of the brushes are designed for thicker coats. If you have a short-haired dog or cat, you probably won’t use every tool in the kit, although the rubber grooming glove would still work well for removing loose hair during bath time or everyday grooming.The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the large sticker placed on the outside of the storage bag. It doesn’t peel off very easily, and I think over time it’s going to fade and make the bag look worn. I would have preferred the bag without the sticker or with a removable tag instead.Everything arrived quickly, was packaged well, and all the pieces were included. Overall, this is a great grooming kit with a lot of useful tools at a very reasonable price. I would definitely recommend it, especially for pet owners with dogs that have longer coats.

authors_reviews.title: A great all inclusive dog grooming kit
authors_reviews.text: Did you just get a puppy or do you have a friend who just rescued a dog? If you did this kit is for you. This is a great set of grooming tools for your dog. It's pretty much all inclusive, it includes all the tools I can think of that you would need to groom your dog besides water and shampoo. All the tools feel solid and well made. The brushes and combs are all great and I'll be using them everyday. The shampoo gloves and towels will help during bath time. The nail clipper and nail file I'll use when working on the dogs nails. I especially like the deshedding and undercoat brush which feels sturdy and well made. This set is a great value for the money, just 1 or 2 of these tools cost as much as this set. This is a great set that will make a good gift for your dog loving friends, someone who just rescued a dog, or if you are looking for an all inclusive grooming kit. I highly recommend this dog grooming kit.
